note: Reel 3 What you get and what it protects (record to action). Voice only, am_adam, no music. 'at' = start second of each line, one line per scene; 'title' = short title under the scene. Facts only from facts/company.yaml and the brief; 'instant' only for the email alert. Closing scene held 8 s so the line and website can be heard.

lines.text: Records pile up. By the time anyone looks, the vehicle is long gone.
lines.title: Seen too late is not seen

lines.text: Now every vehicle shows on the dashboard as it happens, with its plate, type and time.
lines.title: Every vehicle, as it happens

lines.text: An instant email alert reaches your inbox, with the plate image.
lines.title: An alert in your inbox

lines.text: At the gate, only a whitelisted plate lifts the barrier.
lines.title: The gate opens for whitelisted plates only

lines.text: Rule breakers are detected: no helmet, triple riding, no seatbelt, and over speed by radar.
lines.title: Rule breakers, detected

lines.text: The road is watched too: lane change, heavy traffic, congestion, poor visibility, even a person on the highway.
lines.title: The road itself, watched

lines.text: Reports reach your mailbox as PDF, Word or CSV, daily or weekly.
lines.title: Daily or weekly, in your mailbox

lines.text: SytronANPR. Read every plate, track every vehicle, control every gate. www.sytronsoft.com
lines.title: SytronANPR
